definitions.explanation: The act of reading text out loud, such as reading names from a list, reciting results, or reading a document aloud to an audience.
A technology function in which a device or application converts written text into spoken audio. Common in accessibility features and language learning tools.

examples.english: The reading aloud of names began.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {読|よ}み{上|あ}げる (to read aloud). Used both as a noun ({読|よ}み{上|あ}げ) and in verb form. In technology contexts, {読|よ}み{上|あ}げ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ (text-to-speech function) is extremely common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読|よ}み{上|あ}げ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ (text-to-speech function)
- {読|よ}み{上|あ}げ⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧ (text-to-speech software)
- ⟦{音声|おんせい}→音声：04445_onsei⟧{読|よ}み{上|あ}げ (audio reading)
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる (to read names aloud)
